question: Compare normal and exception lubrication plus inspection intervals for the Ruvane Canal Lock misty-chamber chain hoist and Neris Kite Club sandy-enclosure winding reel.

ui.answer:
[1] The Ruvane Canal Lock chain hoist requires lubrication every 110 operating hours under normal conditions.

[2] Lubricate the Neris Kite Club winding reel every 66 operating hours under normal conditions. In a sandy enclosure, lubricate it every 33 operating hours. Inspect the winding reel every 11 operating hours in either enclosure.
